tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything. Never place body text directly on volt; place it on bg, surface or surface-raised.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Section cards (Agenda, Training, Fuel), the day header and sheets.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Anything that floats above a surface: the Voice Dock, menus, the Change Receipt, inputs.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between rows and around cards. Carries no meaning; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, checkboxes). At least 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface and surface-raised (15:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, placeholders, timestamps and empty-state copy on bg, surface and surface-raised (6:1 or more).

tokens.name: volt
tokens.usage: The brand fill: primary buttons, the live microphone orb, today's bar in the Week Pulse. A fill only; text on it is on-volt.

tokens.name: on-volt
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a volt fill (17:1).

tokens.name: volt-ink
tokens.usage: Volt as text or a thin mark on bg, surface or surface-raised: links, active tab labels, the 'listening' caption. Darkens in Day so it stays above 5:1.

tokens.name: agenda
tokens.usage: Category colour for Agenda (activities, appointments): its tag, its bar segment, its row tick. Text-safe on bg, surface and surface-raised (5.4:1 or more).

tokens.name: train
tokens.usage: Category colour for Training. Deliberately the brand colour: training is the power in PowerWeek. Text-safe on every surface.

tokens.name: fuel
tokens.usage: Category colour for Fuel (meals and nutrition notes). Text-safe on bg, surface and surface-raised (4.7:1 or more).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors, always paired with an icon and a word. Text-safe on every surface.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px solid focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element. 14:1 or more on every surface in both themes.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Landing hero and the day name on Today. Uppercase, font-stretch 125% (Archivo Expanded).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Workout titles, sheet titles. Sentence case, font-stretch 112%.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section card headers and list item titles that need weight.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pádel con Marta en el club

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Secondary lines under an item, helper text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase category tags, day initials in the Week Pulse, overlines.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Times, sets × reps, counters. Tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between Week Pulse bars, between stacked rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, screen side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gap between section cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between screen regions.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Landing section rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, checkboxes, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Section cards, inputs, list rows on hover.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The Voice Dock, sheets and the Change Receipt.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, the microphone orb and Week Pulse bars.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Only for things that float over content: the Voice Dock and the Change Receipt.

tokens.name: glow-volt
tokens.usage: The halo around the microphone orb while listening. Pulses; never static decoration.
